IPS officer's mother murdered in UP home, jewellery stolen

The 91-year-old mother of IPS officer Ashutosh Mishra was found murdered in her home in Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. Police reported that jewellery, including a gold chain, nose pin, earrings, and anklets, was missing from the house. Other household items did not appear disturbed. The family suspects thieves may have entered the house. Police are investigating the incident, considering angles of murder, robbery, and a possible heart attack. Some reports noted an injection mark on the victim's hand and blood from her mouth.
